host.title: Local IP of Daikin Air Purifier

code.title: Authorization Code (optional)
code.description: Only needed once. It works a single time; after the first login the plugin saves and renews its own tokens. Put a new code here only if the log asks for one.

refreshToken.title: Refresh Token (optional)
refreshToken.description: Use this instead of the authorization code if you have captured a refresh_token from the Daikin Smart App.

uuid.title: Cognito UUID
uuid.description: Daikin cloud setting, needed only with an Authorization Code. Leave the cloud settings empty for local-only mode.

clientId.title: Client ID
clientId.description: Daikin cloud setting, needed only with an Authorization Code.

clientSecret.title: Client Secret
clientSecret.description: Daikin cloud setting, needed only with an Authorization Code.

terminalId.title: Terminal ID
terminalId.description: Daikin cloud setting, needed to control the purifier.

port.title: Port
port.description: Daikin cloud setting, needed to control the purifier.

cacheDuration.title: Cache Duration (seconds)
cacheDuration.description: How often the purifier is polled on the local network. Controlling it uses the Daikin cloud API only when you change a setting.
